instruction: My uncle is a programmer who needs to read code snippets more clearly. Please increase the fixed-width font size in Chrome to 18 pixels to make monospace text easier to read.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting fixed-width (monospace) font size in Chrome to exactly 18 pixels for better code readability. Evaluator checks if default_fixed_font_size == 18. Uses custom getter to extract default_fixed_font_size from Chrome preferences and custom metric to validate the exact value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the default_fixed_font_size from Chrome's Preferences file (webkit.webprefs.default_fixed_font_size)
Metric performs exact value comparison (default_fixed_font_size == 18), which is semantically correct for the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: The single requirement in the instruction ('increase fixed-width font size to 18 pixels') is fully verified
Postconfig properly restarts Chrome to ensure preference changes are persisted to disk and readable
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts integer value → Metric compares against expected value (18)
Expected value (18) matches the instruction requirement exactly
Edge case handling: Getter returns default value (13) if preference not found, which would correctly fail the verification
